prompt: Build a 4-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.5 * Z0 * Z1 * Z2 * Z3 (a single four-body interaction term). gamma = 0.5. Any correct implementation is accepted (Z0*Z1*Z2*Z3 is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct phase +/-gamma*0.5 depending on the parity of the 4-bit computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition, e.g. a CNOT-ladder-plus-RZ pattern is one valid way but not the only one). No measurement.
